description:
Escape to the Vineyard region in Sydney for a country getaway at Ingenia Holidays Avina! Located only 50km from Sydney CBD, this countryside escape offers a range of accommodation options, from camping and caravan sites to modern villas and spacious cabins.

During your stay, explore nearby attractions like Featherdale Wildlife Park, the Windsor Heritage Walk, Hawkesbury Valley and the Blue Mountains, or simply relax and enjoy the resort‑style pool.
